# Omega Engine — llms.txt
# AI Agent Navigation Sitemap
# https://xoe-nov.ai/llms.txt

> Omega Engine is a sovereign, local-first AI runtime with 13 agents, 10 Pillar Keepers,
> 22 mandates, and 855+ tests. It uses a WAD architecture (IWAD/PWAD) for data-driven
> separation of engine and content.

## Core
- [Omega Engine SSOT](https://github.com/Xoe-NovAi/omega-engine/blob/main/OMEGA_ENGINE.md) — Engine state, architecture, providers
- [Sovereign Mandates](https://github.com/Xoe-NovAi/omega-engine/blob/main/SOVEREIGN_MANDATES.md) — 22 constitutional laws (M1-M22)
- [Oracle Stack](https://github.com/Xoe-NovAi/omega-engine/blob/main/ORACLE_STACK.md) — Post-compaction recovery context
